name: Cook Mode
description: A real cook mode for the kitchen tablet. Connects straight to your Tandoor server: today's meal one tap away, every recipe to browse and search, pictures, one big step at a time, servings that rescale, timers from the recipe's own words, read-aloud, and a screen that stays on while you cook. No Home Assistant integration needed.
author: vednolacni

settings.title: Tandoor address
settings.description: The address you open Tandoor with in a browser, such as http://192.168.1.20:8080.

settings.title: API token
settings.description: In Tandoor, open Settings > API and create a token with the scope "read write". Copy it right after saving: Tandoor shows it only briefly. It stays on this tablet and goes only to the address above.

settings.title: Days of the meal plan
settings.description: Today and the days after it. Meals planned today come first, one tap from cooking.

settings.title: Size of a step's text
settings.description: Short steps grow to fill the screen and long ones shrink to fit, within this size. Large reads well from about one and a half metres on an 8 inch tablet.

settings.title: Split long steps
settings.description: Recipes imported from the web often hold the whole method in one step. This shows each of its paragraphs as a step of its own.

settings.title: Swipe to change steps
settings.description: Turn off if a splashing hand keeps changing the step.

settings.title: Record the meal in Tandoor
settings.description: After the last step, add it to Tandoor's cook log. Never also keeps opened recipes out of Tandoor's recently viewed list.

settings.title: Language
settings.description: Auto follows the device language.

settings.title: Timer sound
settings.description: What plays when a timer ends. Alarm tone is the tablet's own, and a tablet without one beeps instead.

settings.title: Sound stream
settings.description: Which of the tablet's volumes it follows. Choose Media if you only ever set the media volume.

settings.title: Ring for at most
settings.description: The sound stops after this long. The timer stays on the screen until someone stops it.

settings.title: Corner of the timer card
settings.description: While the panel is closed, a small card shows what is cooking and how long the timers have left.

settings.title: Timer card over everything
settings.description: Also over the screensaver, the kiosk's menu and its camera views. Off, it sits with the dashboard.

settings.title: Voice
settings.description: Tablet voice uses Android's text-to-speech, which needs no connection but not every tablet has, and few speak Slovenian. Home Assistant speaks through the kiosk's announcements, with the engine and voice set under Settings > ESPHome > Announcements.

settings.title: ESPHome node of this kiosk
settings.description: Only if reading fails. Empty tries ks_ plus the device's name. It is the middle of the kiosk's action in Home Assistant: esphome.ks_kitchen_announce means ks_kitchen.

settings.title: Read each step by itself
settings.description: Otherwise a step is read when you press the speaker button or run Read step.

settings.title: Keep the screen on while cooking
settings.description: Holds the screensaver back while a recipe is up. A screensaver started by a schedule or a gesture is left alone.

settings.title: Let the screen rest after
settings.description: With nobody touching the tablet for this long, a forgotten recipe stops holding the screen. Any touch or action starts it again, and timers still ring.

settings.title: Close the list when the screensaver starts
settings.description: Only the first page, the way the built-in views go away. A recipe being cooked stays.

settings.title: Saved session
settings.description: Written by the plugin, so the recipe being cooked and its timers survive a restart of the kiosk. Empty it to forget them.

buttons.title: Test connection
buttons.label: Test
buttons.description: Checks the address and the token, and tells which Tandoor answered.

buttons.title: Test the timer sound
buttons.label: Ring
buttons.description: Rings for a few seconds and reports the tablet's volume, so a silent alarm shows before dinner.
